verdict.rationale: Undermind mentions 'Programmatic queries via API' for enterprise customers, but there is no evidence of an actual SDK (client library, language bindings, code samples) and probes show 404s for OpenAPI specs and docs pages, indicating no publicly documented API/SDK exists. The MCP server integration is a protocol connector, not an SDK for building custom integrations. missing for 10: SDK client libraries, language-specific bindings, code examples, publicly accessible API/OpenAPI documentation.
